name: YAATD (Yet Another AI Tools Directory)

sources.title: Homepage — live SvelteKit SPA, dark/light theme, JS-rendered directory
'Submit your AI tool' — multi-step wizard (Fill the form → review → publish)
Sitemap — confirms /submit/ and per-tool /t/<slug>/ listing pages

requirements: AI tools only — directory is organized into /t/<slug>/ tool pages and /categories/
Submission is a multi-step wizard at /submit/ ('Start submission → Fill the form — Title, link, description')
Entire site is JS-rendered SvelteKit — the wizard requires a JS-capable client
workflow: Open https://yaatd.com/submit/ in a JS-capable browser
Step through the wizard: fill title, link, description, category
watchFor: SPA-only — no SSR fallback; curl/static fetches return an empty shell
Pricing/free status could not be determined from the static shell — verify inside the wizard before assuming free
Young-looking directory (low DR in seed data) — treat reach expectations accordingly
countsAsLive: The tool appears at yaatd.com/t/<slug>/ and in its category listing
unknowns: Whether listing is free or paid — wizard is JS-gated
Link type (dofollow vs nofollow) on published listings
